gate_rule: Train 50000 producer macro decisions/run only if source-bound development sensitivity, tiny fits and on-device <=20ms warm p95 pass. Otherwise 512 engineering decisions/run.
training: cooperative macro MAPPO, fixed receiver/reverse roles, raw v6 task reward, no shaping or teacher subtraction
validation: all six fixed final models on 24 newly allocated prospective cases; no selection or tuning; original reserved sets untouched
scope: planned 50k cap; initial 2k engineering updates remain provably greedy teacher by training-weight bounds. Same architecture/reward/guards. Expanded training bank is not a controlled budget-only comparison.
seed_allocation: Original 24 training cases plus 24 additional cases. New cases checked against all integer fields in prior public configs/artifacts. Prior calibration bank retained unused; prior pilot validation not reused.
